hook: Early X-ray decay spectra separate collapsar gamma-ray bursts from merger-driven ones
hook_turn: separate collapsar gamma-ray bursts from merger-driven ones
summary: Fitting the steep X-ray decay of 23 Swift bursts from collapsing stars, the authors find that spectral peak energy and cooling frequency track luminosity along a line distinct from merger candidates. They also offer a photon index and luminosity cut for Einstein Probe transients. The collapsar sample is small, and the merger comparison relies on candidates rather than confirmed events.
title: Early X-ray emission as an observational diagnostic of gamma-ray burst progenitors
